# Happimess

> Home organization, storage furniture, trash management, and kitchen products — designed to make clutter-free living stylish and accessible. NYC-based Shopify store, founded 2020. Ships to all 48 contiguous US states. Products tested for a minimum of 30 days before catalog inclusion; sensor and pedal mechanisms tested for 500+ open/close cycles; lid-seal odor containment tested over 15 days.

## Store

- [Homepage](https://happimess.com/): Full product catalog — trash cans, storage bins, organization furniture, kitchen accessories, scented trash liners
- [Trash Cans Collection](https://happimess.com/collections/trash): Sensor/touchless, step-open, and dual-compartment trash cans for kitchen and bathroom; 8–17 gallon capacity range
- [Organization Collection](https://happimess.com/collections/organization): Storage bins, drawer organizers, hampers, closet solutions, coat racks
- [Storage Furniture Collection](https://happimess.com/collections/storage-furniture): Wicker storage benches, trunks, shelving, and multi-drawer storage units
- [Kitchen & Bathroom Collection](https://happimess.com/collections/kitchen): Dish racks, pantry organizers, kitchen accessories, bathroom organization
- [Subscribe & Save](https://happimess.com/pages/refill-page): Subscription refill program for Happimess scented trash liners — lemon and lavender
